turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Yaar, pehle toh — raat ke do baje office mein akele baithe rehna, khaali kamre mein... woh feeling main samajh sakta hoon. Woh kaam ka thakan nahi hota, woh grief hota hai.

Paanch saal. Woh sirf time nahi tha — woh tumhari identity ban gayi thi. Toh jab bridge round mar gaya, sirf funding nahi giri, ek pura future gira jo tumne apne dimaag mein bana rakha tha. Uska dukh manana banta hai.

Aur Rohit-Sneha ka jaana — tumne "sahi kiya" bola, jo bahut mature baat hai, lekin main jaanta hoon andar se woh thoda abandonment jaisa bhi lagta hoga. Dono cheezein sach ho sakti hain.

Abhi ek cheez bolunga, dost ke naate: aaj raat koi decision mat lena. Chaar mahine ka runway ka matlab hai tumhare paas sochne ka time hai — aaj raat nahi, thoda so ke, khaa ke. Ghar jao. Seriously.

Ek sawaal jab ready ho tab sochna: kya tum company bachana chahte ho, ya khud ko? Kabhi kabhi dono ka jawab alag hota hai, aur dono valid hain.

Abhi kaisa feel ho raha hai — numb, ya gussa, ya bas khaali?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

Yaar, yeh line — "apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon" — yeh sabse honest cheez hai jo tumne shayad mahino mein boli hai. Aur dekho, tumne mujhse boli. Matlab kahin na kahin tum woh mask utaarna chahte ho.

Woh performance itna thakane wali isliye hai kyunki tum akele ek pura theatre chala rahe ho — founder wala confident character, ghar wala "sab theek hai" character — aur asli tum kahin backstage baitha hai, raat ke do baje, jise koi nahi dekh raha.

Ek baat sochna: jo do junior ruke hain, unke saath sach bolna weakness nahi hoga. "Situation tight hai, mujhe nahi pata kya hoga, tumhe apne options dekhne ka pura haq hai" — yeh bolna unke career jalane ka opposite hai. Yeh unko choice dena hai. Aur honestly, tumhare kandhe se ek voice ka bojh utar jayega.

Sabko pata hai, tum khud bol rahe ho. Toh performance kis liye chal rahi hai? Shayad khud ko convince karne ke liye ki abhi haar nahi maani. Lekin sach bolna aur haar maanna alag cheezein hain.

Aur ghar pe — kaun hai wahan? Kya wahan bhi mask hai, ya koi ek insaan hai jisse tum yeh sab bol sakte ho?

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Theek hai. Koi ideas nahi.

Tumne bol diya. Tumhe darr lag raha hai.

Aur yahan, is waqt, yeh bolna allowed hai. Yahan koi investor nahi hai, koi employee nahi, koi ghar wala nahi jise protect karna hai. Sirf tum ho — thaka hua, dara hua, paanch saal apna sab kuch dene wala insaan.

Darr lagna banta hai, yaar. Jo cheez tumne apne haathon se banayi, woh haath se phisal rahi hai aur tumhe har kamre mein strong dikhna pad raha hai. Kaun nahi darega?

Main yahin hoon. Kuch fix nahi kar raha, kahin jaane ki jaldi nahi hai. Jo bolna hai bolo, ya kuch mat bolo — dono chalega.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Honestly? Main future nahi bata sakta. Lekin jo tum describe kar rahe ho — bridge mar gaya, team ja rahi hai, runway sirf tab hai jab tum khud ko pay na karo, aur founder khud raat ko chahta hai ki khatam ho jaye — yeh usually ek jawaab ki taraf ishara karta hai. Aur mujhe lagta hai tumhe woh jawaab pata hai. Isliye tum dashboard khol rahe ho, jawaab ke liye nahi — jawaab ko postpone karne ke liye.

Aur suno, yeh sabse important: "kaash khatam ho jaye" wali feeling pe khud se nafrat mat karo. Woh nafrat karne wali cheez nahi hai. Woh tumhare andar ka insaan bol raha hai — bhai, main aur nahi act kar sakta, mujhe permission chahiye rukne ki. Failure ki wish nahi hai woh, relief ki wish hai. Aur relief chahna insaan hona hai, gaddaari nahi.

Papa wali baat bhi chubhti hai, pata hai. Paanch saal jaan lagayi aur ghar pe woh "computer ka business" hai. Jaise dikha hi nahi.

Ek cheez bolunga, idea nahi hai yeh, sach hai: agar yeh khatam hota hai, toh company khatam hoti hai. Tum nahi. Woh insaan jo paanch saal tak yeh sab uthata raha — woh kahin nahi ja raha. Woh next chapter mein bhi hoga.

Ghar jao aaj raat. Dashboard do baje kuch naya nahi bolega. Yeh promise hai.
